Revolutionizing Performance With Gen AI-Focused Solutions

The Hackett Group ® combines Gen AI expertise with unmatched Digital World Class ® performance insights to redefine excellence. Our Hackett AI XPLR ™ and ZBrain ® platforms empower organizations to ideate, evaluate, build, and deploy AI-driven solutions quickly and with confidence.
The Architects of Your Gen AI Journey
Your digital gateway to measure performance excellence, accelerate business transformation and uncover breakthrough business insights.

With our Hackett AI XPLR ™ and ZBrain ® platforms, we revolutionized digital transformation using Gen AI. Combining technology with Digital World Class ® intellectual property, we architect your journey to achieve breakthrough performance.
Accelerate smarter decisions with expert-led, AI-enabled support built on decades of enterprise execution know-how.
Our business benchmarking services assess organizational performance, enabling companies to pinpoint and implement Gen AI-enabled improvements to achieve Digital World Class ® performance.
By combining empirical, data-driven insights with a cutting-edge evaluation method, we help position vendors to accelerate sales and deliver greater value to clients.
Our technology experts implement and integrate enterprise software using proven best practices, empowering organizations to unlock the full potential of your technology investments, including Gen AI.

The Hackett Group ® knows the proven practices and Gen AI technologies of the world’s best businesses. We use this insight to help organizations rethink their operations, make smarter decisions, and achieve new levels of efficiency, innovation, and growth. Partner with us to unlock the potential of your business.
The Americas, Europe and Asia
As a Coupa Premier Partner, we provide eProcurement expertise and proprietary intellectual property to drive toward world-class procure-to-pay (P2P) performance.

As a OneStream Diamond Partner, The Hackett Group ® has the application and corporate performance management expertise to connect finance processes and equip your organization for excellence and agility in a digital world.

As an Oracle ® Platinum Partner, The Hackett Group ® offers the deep application experience and proven best practices you need to run efficiently, compete effectively and adapt quickly to evolving markets.

Answerthink ® , a Hackett Group company, is a certified SAP Platinum Partner and member of United VARS. Leveraging our extensive SAP ® experience and repository of best practices, we help growing companies run efficiently in a digital world.
